column4: Every AI tool tells founders to pivot.
You don't need a new idea. You need the angle that wins.
This is Wedge. Direction, backed by evidence.
Paste your idea. Wedge reads competitor pages, Hacker News and Reddit, keeps only the most relevant evidence, and drafts three routes.
Then the agent stops. Three routes, every claim cited, held by a real LangGraph interrupt.
Now you throw the lever. Pick your route, steer it with what only you know, and rule on every assumption. The signal won't clear until you do.
Signal clear. A fourteen-day plan, a cited hook, and interview questions for what you couldn't verify.
Groq, with an automatic Gemini fallback. Every claim cited. Zero euros to run.
The agent stops at red. You throw the lever. This is Wedge.
